qualityClaim: offline protocol regression only; NOT real LLM quality

dataset.provenance: 37 hand-authored synthetic public protocol cases; no sampled users or production data.

retrieval.lexical: MemoryVault.search; semantic:false; limit:20; expandLinks:false; full actual hit documents

config.setup: deterministic public fixture compiler, real vault APIs; approved ordinary memory and Wiki; each case reopened before query

usage.costBudgetLimit: Checked before each request against reported usage. A final in-flight request may exceed the supplied cost threshold; this is not a prepaid hard cap. Missing usage stops subsequent paid requests when a cost budget is set.
